title: X-Content-Type-Options present with a non-nosniff value
description: The response carries an X-Content-Type-Options header whose value is not nosniff. A present-but-wrong value looks like protection in a header inventory while leaving MIME sniffing enabled, so a resource served with an ambiguous type can still be reinterpreted as script. The check compares the observed value.
remediation: Send exactly X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and pair it with accurate Content-Type values (nosniff on every response).
limitation: Header value only: multiple values and case variants are compared literally apart from letter case.
